description.value:
Tier Undying

Effect any ally who has fought beside you for at least this encounter can be targeted by your Cadre commands regardless of distance or intervening obstacles, so long as they're on the same field of battle

Distance stops mattering to anyone who has fought beside you.

cinderfall.incomplete: Any ally who's fought beside the caster this encounter can be Cadre-commanded regardless of distance/obstacles, on the same battlefield. Same "nothing to extend" gap -- no range value exists on the unbuilt base command mechanic.
